Subject: Next steps & constraints: Private hosting for Aston Biomed

Thanks again for taking the time today — good conversation. Short recap so we have alignment and explicit next steps. If anything below is off, please flag.

Key pain points you shared
- Data residency & regulatory: primary requirement is that patient data never leaves Aston Biomed-controlled network; regional residency in the US (East) and audit-ready logs (HIPAA + SOC2 evidence) are mandatory.
- Air-gap-like constraints: inference nodes must not have direct internet egress; only managed, one-way updates initiated by your ops are acceptable.
- Procurement timeline: legal/infosec review and procurement window targeted within 6–8 weeks; budget holder is in procurement (cc'd contact).
- Latency & throughput goals: sub-200ms p95 for single-turn prompts; burst capacity up to 40 concurrent requests during batch inference windows.

Technical constraints we captured
- No outbound connections from inference hosts except to a pinned set of Redwood control endpoints over TLS using client certs.
- Allowed egress CIDR will be provided by your netops; expect mutual-auth TLS (mTLS) for control-plane calls.
- SMK/KMS requirement: you will use your HSM/KMS for key wrapping; Redwood must support external KMS integration.

Proposed short-term path (next 2 weeks)
1) We will share a focused checklist: network ports, IP ranges, and cert requirements (attached: redwood-private-deploy-checklist). — Action: Redwood (Priyom) by Wed, Jun 24.
2) Technical deep-dive with your NetOps + Security to validate egress constraints and HSM integration (30–45m). — Action: schedule by Aston Biomed; proposed slots below.
3) Draft mutual action plan / SOW outline capturing delivery milestones and procurement triggers (attached: mutual-action-plan-draft.docx). — Action: Redwood (Monica) by Fri, Jun 26.

Proposed meeting times for deep-dive (PDT): Tue Jun 23 10:00–11:00, Tue Jun 23 15:00–15:45, Wed Jun 24 09:00–09:45. Please confirm which works for NetOps/Security.

Attachments included in this thread: redwood-private-deploy-checklist.pdf, aston-networking-requirements.xlsx, mutual-action-plan-draft.docx (we'll update post-call).

Thanks — looking forward to the deep-dive.

—

Subject: Re: Next steps & constraints: Private hosting for Aston Biomed

Thanks Priyom — clear summary and exactly the level of detail we need. A few clarifications from our side after syncing with NetOps this morning:
- Network: our policy today is no persistent outbound from secure inference enclaves. We can allow outbound to a pinned control endpoint over mTLS, but it must be whitelisted and reviewed by our firewall team (we will provide the change window and approver).
- KMS/HSM: we use an on-prem HSM (Thales) and will expect the redwood agent to support wrapping keys with an external KMS.
- Audit/logging: we require immutable audit logs for inference requests and admin access; a daily export to our SIEM is required.

Procurement note: procurement (cc) requests a high-level commercial summary and an estimated TCO range for a dedicated private deployment (monthly) so they can tee up the purchase request this week. If you can provide a 1–page commercial snapshot we can attach, that would speed things.

We can confirm Tue Jun 23 15:00–15:45 for the tech deep-dive. Attendees: Daniel Park (NetOps), Ravi Kumar (Security), and myself. See procurement copied for schedule visibility.

Lena
VP Product & Engineering | Aston Biomed
lena.ortiz@astonbiomed.com
